page_title: MAL 0-1 ATM | Mallorca v Atletico Madrid 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' The foul by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jose Sanchez.

90+1' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The attendance for today's match is 19500.
87' The total number of attempts is 11:8.
86' Here is a change. Rodrigo Riquelme is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
85' Jan Oblak pulls off a great save to deny Abdon Prats (Mallorca), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
83' Substitution. Daniel Luna (Mallorca) has come on for Manu Morlanes.
83' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Sanchez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' Samu Costa (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
81' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

79' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
79' One of the players from Atl. Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' Chiquinho (Mallorca) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jan Oblak comes off the line to clear the ball away.
77' Jose Sanchez blows for a foul after Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
75' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Robert Navarro and he is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Maffeo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
74' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jan Oblak, who smothers the ball.
72' 4:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
69' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) replaces Cyle Larin.
69' Sergi Darder will be replaced by Chiquinho (Mallorca).
68' Mallorca quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Mallorca will take a corner kick.

65' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Dominik Greif guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
63' Referee Jose Sanchez halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jagoba Arrasate, then shows him a yellow.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Clement Lenglet can be given a rest.
62' It's time for a substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of Julian Alvarez.
62' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) replacing Antoine Griezmann.
62' The manager makes a subsitution with Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) coming on for Giuliano Simeone.
61' 0 - 1 GOAL! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a pass from Giuliano Simeone after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:1.
61' The ball goes behind for a corner. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

60' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Mallorca force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort goes towards the middle of the goal. Not a big deal for the goalkeeper.
58' Samu Costa (Mallorca) gets a yellow card. The referee Jose Sanchez made the right call.
55' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
54' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
52' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Cyle Larin (Mallorca), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
47' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
46' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
46' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Mallorca take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
42' Mallorca keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
41' The percentage of ball possession is – 51:49.
40' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
34' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Sanchez signals.
32' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
29' 1:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
26' A lofted cross from Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
24' Mallorca take a short corner kick.
24' Good clearance! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
22' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
20' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
18' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
15' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
14' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Mallorca.
12' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
12' Atl. Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
8' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' Koke (Atl. Madrid) takes a short corner kick.
4' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will referee today's match.
